source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 19 May 1955, p. 8 ("Borough and urban councils elections results"); Irish News, 19 May 1955, p. 5 ("Unionist Deputy Mayor loses seat in Carrick")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: "West Central Ward—Aldermanship, H. Erwin [OCR Erwln], 270 (elected); J. C. M'Quitty [OCR M'Qultty], 188" (BNL 19 May 1955 p. 8); Irish News 19 May 1955 p. 5: the Deputy Mayor (Mr. J. C. McQuitty) lost his seat to Mr. H. S. Erwin

note: Municipal elections, 18 May 1955; contests in four wards for eight seats. Four aldermen were returned unopposed (BNL 5 May 1955 p. 6); their wards are inferred from earlier returns (see each contest). Two further members, Mrs M. Beattie and Mrs A. Doherty, were also returned unopposed (Irish News, 5 May 1955, p. 5), but no source found places them in a ward or says whether they were aldermen or councillors, so they are not shown against a ward (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).
